claims.text: Rowboat positions itself as a local-first AI coworker whose long-lived working memory is plain Markdown / Obsidian-compatible notes stored on the user's machine.
Rowboat exposes typed agent definitions with builtin, MCP, and agent-as-tool attachments, and scheduled agent entries for cron/window/once schedules.
Rowboat's run runtime persists JSONL run logs, uses a run lock/abort flow, emits permission and ask-human events, and supports nested agent subflows.

Rowboat Live Notes implement a concrete note-agent pattern: one objective in frontmatter, backend-only writes for live metadata, timed scheduler, lastAttempt/lastRun separation, per-note concurrency guard, FIFO pending/done event queue, and liberal Pass-1 routing followed by agent veto.

Rowboat includes useful reference patterns but also shell, MCP, OAuth, Composio, and API-key surfaces that Hermes must not wholesale import without sandbox, permission, timeout, redaction, and proof-chain review.

evidence.summary: README claims Rowboat is an open-source AI coworker, local-first, with Obsidian-compatible plain Markdown vault and user-inspectable/editable notes stored locally.
ToolAttachment is a discriminated union of builtin, mcp, and agent; Agent includes name/provider/model/description/instructions/tools.
CronSchedule, WindowSchedule, OnceSchedule, AgentScheduleEntry, and AgentScheduleConfig define scheduled agents.
Runs are stored as JSONL events; fetch/list parse run metadata and logs from disk.
AgentRuntime.trigger locks a run, creates an abort signal, loops over event replay/tool execution/LLM steps, and releases lock; stop() aborts or force-closes MCP clients.
Permission and ask-human events are tracked in AgentState; responses append events and trigger runtime continuation.
Agent-type tools are mapped to a message-taking tool and execute by recursively streaming a subflow agent.

Live Note documentation specifies one live: block with objective/triggers/runtime fields, backend-only writes, scheduler/event processor/runner flow, and concurrency/FIFO guarantees. Note: line 223 says lastRunAt set at start, while runner code shows lastAttemptAt at start and lastRunAt on success; code is treated as authoritative.
Scheduler polls every 15 seconds, scans knowledge markdown, skips inactive notes, checks dueTimedTrigger/backoffRemainingMs, and fires runLiveNoteAgent asynchronously.

runningLiveNotes per-file guard; lastAttemptAt and lastRunId written before execution; waitForRunCompletion throwOnError; lastRunAt/summary only on success; lastRunError on failure; cleanup in finally.

Events are JSON files in events/pending and events/done; monotonic IDs make sorted filenames FIFO; malformed events are quarantined to done with error; processed events are enriched with candidates and run IDs.
Routing prompt is liberal and prefers false positives; targetFilePath short-circuits; candidates are batched by 20 and returned as Pass1OutputSchema filePaths.
withFileLock serializes per-file mutations; set/patch/delete/toggle live note helpers use it for backend-owned live block changes.
README documents optional Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Exa, Composio API-key files and MCP external tools.
Shell commands are checked against allowlists, then executed through shell exec or abortable spawn with process-group killing.
MCP client supports stdio command/args/env and remote URL transports; listTools and executeTool call SDK client methods directly.
execTool checks abort before start, but MCP tools are allowed to complete on graceful stop; this is not enough for Hermes' fail-closed timeout expectations without extra wrappers.
Apache License 2.0; reference allowed, but Hermes should still use clean-room pattern extraction rather than code copy.

recommendations_under_review.title: Taskpool signal event queue with pending/done/error ledger
recommendations_under_review.why: Rowboat's pending/done event ledger maps cleanly to Hermes taskpool signals while keeping Markdown tasks canonical and the queue derived/rebuildable.
recommendations_under_review.next_slice: Design a local-brain event artifact schema with source/type/payload/processedAt/error/proof_hash; implement read-only processor first; no task mutation in first slice.

recommendations_under_review.title: Objective/triggers/runtime-field separation for task envelopes
recommendations_under_review.why: Hermes mission envelopes already carry objective/constraints/proof fields; Rowboat reinforces explicit separation between user-authored intent and runtime-managed fields.
recommendations_under_review.next_slice: Add deterministic audit only: detect tasks where runtime fields are missing/inconsistent before writing new validators.

recommendations_under_review.title: Liberal pass-1 routing plus executor/task verifier veto
recommendations_under_review.why: This can reduce missed taskpool interventions while preserving Hermes fail-closed mutation gates through a second deterministic or model-reviewed veto stage.
recommendations_under_review.next_slice: Replay current taskpool trigger logs offline and measure false positives/false negatives; no write surface.

recommendations_under_review.title: Do not import Rowboat runtime, Electron app, Composio integrations, or MCP layer wholesale
recommendations_under_review.why: Those surfaces overlap Hermes gateway/cron/memory/tooling and would bypass or duplicate Hermes proof-chain, timeout, redaction, and local-brain controls.
recommendations_under_review.next_slice: Clean-room documentation and Hermes-native scripts only; no dependency/import/install decision without separate supply-chain certification.
